purpose: Layout-only snapshot of existing backend/src/packets.ts and programs/scfhp-eaa.ts output for an empty fictional case. Not a policy-verification fixture.

missingItems.description: Confirm the current official application form and its version with the program.
Confirm which information belongs in each field before preparing the official form.
Verify the current intake route and submission instructions with the program.
Confirm whether the program is currently accepting requests.

Confirm whether this document is required and who should supply it: Professional order and individualized equipment/service justification; confirm the appropriate author and supporting equipment information.

Confirm whether this document is required and who should supply it: Relevant discharge and support-agency records, if available and applicable; their absence does not establish refusal or ineligibility.
Confirm whether this document is required and who should supply it: Home suitability documentation and PT/OT evaluation when required; the plan determines whether an evaluation exception applies.

Confirm whether this document is required and who should supply it: Itemized estimates in the form’s four cost categories, with two provider bids where possible; confirm scope and any cost exception with the plan.

Confirm whether this document is required and who should supply it: Owner permission and property acknowledgements for applicable installed work; obtain actual documents rather than inferring them from reported permission.
Confirm whether this document is required and who should supply it: Actual member/representative consent and the referring person’s reviewed attestation and signature; the app does not supply these.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Plan product, active enrollment and service area: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (program): SCFHP publishes this route for Medi-Cal and DualConnect members, and DHCS lists EAA for SCFHP in Santa Clara County. Ask the plan to verify this person’s product, active enrollment and applicable service area; a typed plan name or county does not establish them.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Clinical need and institutionalization risk: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (professional): A qualified professional must document the clinical need and relevant care setting. Home observations do not establish these determinations.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Requested adaptation and permitted scope: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (program): Have the plan review the requested adaptation, its medical or remedial purpose and any applicable scope exception. An observed hazard alone does not establish a covered service.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Other coverage and duplicate services: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (program): Ask the plan whether an available Medi-Cal or Medicare benefit can achieve the same goals, and whether other funded services would duplicate this request. Do not assume an alternative is available or sufficient.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Assessment and supporting evaluation: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (professional): Coordinate the required professional order and individualized justification, home suitability review and any applicable PT/OT evaluation. The plan must confirm whether approval without a therapy evaluation applies; missing paperwork alone does not establish ineligibility.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Property acknowledgements: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (resident): With the plan’s guidance, obtain the owner’s written permission and applicable property acknowledgements for installed work in a home the member does not own. Reported permission is not signed documentation; missing paperwork does not establish refusal.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Cost limit and applicable exceptions: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (program): The DHCS and SCFHP guides state a $7,500 lifetime limit with exceptions; the referral form says per authorization. Ask the plan to confirm the applicable limit and exception interpretation. Do not infer a renewed allowance or reject an unresolved exception.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Prior EAA use and remaining funding: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (program): Ask the plan to verify prior EAA payments and the funding history relevant to this request. Missing history is not zero prior use, and the app cannot calculate a remaining allowance from the current profile.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Consent to services and data sharing: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (resident): Obtain the member’s actual consent through the appropriate process. No answer is inferred from use of this app or reported owner permission.

Confirm the unresolved requirement: Applicable policy and current intake: current program rules need verification before this check can be used. Manual review (program): Confirm the governing policy, accepted form and current intake with the plan. DHCS still labels the July 2026 Volume 1 changes proposed; this review does not establish adoption, a complete effective period or open capacity.
